title: French Bean and Spinach Tart (Spanakopita)
description: A French-inspired twist on the classic Greek spanakopita, featuring a rich buttery crust and a delicious bean and spinach filling.
instructions: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 30 seconds, then drain and chop.
In a pan, sauté the chopped spinach with the robust cheese, refreshing herbs, and a pinch of salt until well combined.
Roll out the spanakopita pastry and place it on a baking sheet.
Spread the spinach and cheese mixture evenly over the pastry, leaving a 1cm border around the edges.
Dot the top of the filling with the melted butter.
In a small bowl, beat the eggs and brush the edges of the pastry with the egg wash.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling to form a crust.
Bake the tart in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
